seriess.title: Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices: Total for Germany
seriess.notes:
The Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) gives comparable measures of inflation for the countries and country groups for which it is produced. It is a macroeconomic indicator that measures the change over time of the prices of consumer goods and services acquired by households. For more details, see the source website https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/hicp/information-data.
